# scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] DLP Data Filtering Profile resource (`/v2/api/data-filtering-profiles`). Manages scan directions, file type scopes, user coaching, exclusions, and severity actions linked 1:1 to a Data Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every data profile gets a companion data filtering profile from the backend.
# This resource configures it; destroying it only removes it from state.
resource "scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile" "pci_enforcement" {
  data_profile_id = tonumber(scm_dlp_data_profile.pci_and_employee_pii.id)
  direction       = "both"
  scan_type       = "include"
  file_based      = true
  non_file_based  = true
  file_type       = ["pdf", "csv", "docx", "xlsx"]
  log_severity    = "HIGH"
  rule1_action    = "block"

  app_exclusion_list = [
    {
      app_id   = "jira"
      app_name = "Jira"
      type     = "application-filter"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_profile_id` (Number) The ID of the parent data profile this filtering profile is linked to.
- `file_based` (Boolean) Whether to scan file-based traffic.
- `non_file_based` (Boolean) Whether to scan non-file-based traffic.

### Optional

- `app_exclusion_list` (Attributes List) List of application exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_exclusion_list))
- `description` (String) Description of the data filtering profile.
- `direction` (String) Scan direction: `both`, `c2s` (upload), `s2c` (download).
- `euc_template_id` (String) The End User Coaching template ID.
- `exception_rules` (Attributes List) List of exception rules overriding standard actions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exception_rules))
- `file_type` (List of String) List of file types to scan or filter.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data filtering profile. If omitted during creation, it is auto-resolved from the data_profile_id.
- `is_end_user_coaching_enabled` (Boolean) Whether End User Coaching (EUC) is enabled for this profile.
- `log_severity` (String) Log severity: `CRITICAL`, `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`, `INFORMATIONAL`.
- `name` (String) The name of the data filtering profile.
- `rule1_action` (String) Action for rule 1 (e.g. `alert`, `block`, `allow`). Maps to `rule1.action` in the API.
- `rule2_action` (String) Action for rule 2 (e.g. `alert`, `block`, `allow`). Maps to `rule2.action` in the API.
- `scan_type` (String) Scan type: `include` or `exclude`.
- `url_exclusion_list` (Attributes List) List of URL exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--url_exclusion_list))

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.

<a id="nestedatt--app_exclusion_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `app_exclusion_list`

Required:

- `app_id` (String) Application ID.

Optional:

- `app_name` (String) Application name.
- `type` (String) Application type.


<a id="nestedatt--exception_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exception_rules`

Optional:

- `action` (String) Exception rule action (e.g. `allow`, `alert`, `block`).
- `log_severity` (String) Exception rule log severity.
- `name` (String) Exception rule name.


<a id="nestedatt--url_exclusion_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `url_exclusion_list`

Required:

- `url_id` (String) URL ID.

Optional:

- `type` (String) URL type.
- `url_name` (String) URL pattern or name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP data filtering profile by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile.example <id>
```
